integrity: Analytic conditional-multinomial central limit proof, exact clock coupling; finite computational checks are non-exhaustive and not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Equal coupon probabilities; one copy required per type; fixed finite number of multiplicity classes; only weak convergence. Previously known first-order exponential limit; equivalent second-order formulations may remain in unexamined literature.
title: A multivariate Laplace fluctuation law for coupon frequencies at completion
